$schema_note: Release-gate policy for the security scan that runs on every deploy. This file is STRICTER than .security/lint-baseline.json: the lint baseline records linter findings we tolerate, while this file encodes the hard invariants that must never regress. Any drift fails the release. Update it only with a written reason and a matching @security-memory update.

anonExecutableFunctions.$note: public-schema SECURITY DEFINER functions that anon (unauthenticated visitors) may still EXECUTE. Deliberately empty: the share-token lookups get_class_by_share_token and get_recording_by_token were moved behind the class-by-token edge function and revoked from anon. Re-adding an entry here re-opens an RLS-bypassing function to the public internet.

tablesRequiringRls.$note: Every table in the public schema must have RLS enabled. List exceptions here only for tables that are intentionally world-readable reference data with no user content.

criticalAuthChecks.$note: Live probes run against the deployed site with the publishable anon key. Each table must NOT return rows to an unauthenticated caller. A 200 with a non-empty array fails the release.
criticalAuthChecks.$rpc_note: Privileged RPCs that must reject an unauthenticated caller outright (403/404 from PostgREST once EXECUTE is revoked).

routesMustResolve.$note: Reachability only. The app is a SPA behind a catch-all fallback, so any path returns 200 — these probes prove the deploy is serving traffic (i.e. a lockdown did not take the site down), NOT that a given route renders. Route-level correctness is covered by smoke.yml.
